business_summary.text: Swaraj Suiting Limited is an integrated textile manufacturing company specializing in denim and cotton finished fabrics as well as cotton yarn. The company operates across almost the entire textile value chain – Spinning, Warping, Yarn Dyeing, Weaving, Fabric Processing, and Finishing.

penalties.details: The Deputy Commissioner, State Tax, Ratlam Division, Madhya Pradesh has passed an order imposing a penalty of RS.20,000 on the Company for non-filing of Form GST ITC-04 pertaining to the tax periods of May 2023 and June 2023 (FY 2023–24), under the applicable provisions of the Goods and Services Tax laws.
penalties.impact: The Company has duly paid the penalty of Rs.20,000.

timeline.summary: Swaraj Suiting allotted 33,000 equity shares upon warrant conversion, raising ₹0.58 Cr.
In May 2026, Swaraj Suiting submitted the CRISIL Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26, highlighting a ₹4.80 Cr excess utilization in working capital from preferential issue proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹207.25 Cr, net profit ₹24.68 Cr.
2026-05-28: Swaraj Suiting reported FY26 financial results with 38.5% revenue growth and announced a ₹420 Cr expansion into spinning and technical textiles.
Swaraj Suiting allotted 4,65,000 equity shares upon warrant conversion, raising ₹8.23 Cr.
